messages:
sam_sales: FYI we hit a hard stop on the VertexHealth pilot. CTO (Raj) wants an exec-level cost commitment + proof we can keep data inside eu-central-1. He also wants Okta SSO + 180d audit logs. Asking for a $8k/mo pilot number to get signoff. Need quick triage. @tess_infra @omar_ops @nadia_legal @frank_fin
tess_infra: Understood. What model + traffic profile are they running? If they're at high concurrency we may need Dedicated GPU to hit p99 targets.
sam_sales: They're testing redwood/llama-lite-pro with bursts to 80 qps, p99 ~300ms on hosted. Target is p99 <= 180ms.
omar_ops: Data residency: we can provision Dedicated in eu-central-1 but we'd need VPC peering and a KMS arrangement. BYO-KMS supported but requires LOA and network ACLs.
nadia_legal: If they're BYO-KMS we need a key access agreement and a short amendment. I'll prep a template but need customer LOA + their vendor self-assessment for Okta SSO.
anya_ciso: Security: 180d logs retention is doable but increases storage costs; need to confirm which logs (audit vs request logs). Also require SCIM/Okta config details.
frank_fin: $8k/mo seems tight. Current estimate for Dedicated with quantized runner + 180d logs is ~$11-12k/mo. We could offer a temporary pilot discount (30% off) for 3 months if exec signs off today.
sam_sales: Raj wants a hard cap though. Can we put a spending cap at $8k/mo and alert + throttle? He said if usage exceeds we should throttle until they confirm.
tess_infra: We can implement a per-customer throttle and automated alerting at 75% spend. Throttle behavior can be 429s + retry-after header. That will satisfy 'hard cap' for now.
omar_ops: I'll open infra ticket to provision eu-central Dedicated and start VPC peering. Need contact for their networking person.
billing-bot: Billing ticket created: BILL-6621  Pilot discount request for VertexHealth. Owner: frank_fin.
nadia_legal: I'll send the LOA and an amendment draft; ETA EOD today if I get their LOA now. Include a clause for BYO-KMS attestation and key rotation window.
anya_ciso: Action: I'll send a short security checklist and request SCIM metadata. Also need their data classification and SOC2 report.
frank_fin: If legal approves the 3-month pilot discount, finance will sign off conditionally pending usage cap and a refundable deposit of one month.
sam_sales: I'll push back to Raj and ask for the LOA + SCIM metadata now. Also requesting exec signoff timeline (he said EOD tomorrow).
tess_infra: Plan: (1) spin a small Dedicated canary in eu-central with quant runner tonight, capture perf for 2 hours. (2) implement throttle + alerting policy. (3) confirm SSO/SCIM config once customer provides metadata. I'll post perf logs here.
omar_ops: I'll start VPC peering request and reserve IP ranges; will need their ASN for BGP or we can do private peering. ETA 8 hours.
billing-bot: Quota created: quota-vertex-001  200k tokens/day + spend cap $8000/mo (enforced alert + throttle).
sam_sales: Summary & owners: Tess (perf canary + throttle), Omar (VPC/KMS peering), Nadia (LOA + amendment), Anya (security checklist), Frank (finance discount & deposit). Raj expects decision by EOD tomorrow; please flag any blockers now. :raised_hands:
frank_fin: Noted. I'll review legal amendment when ready. If deposit accepted we'll sign pilot discount.
tess_infra: I'll post smoke numbers in this thread in ~3h.
sam_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll nudge Raj for LOA + SCIM metadata now. :phone:
anya_ciso: Also note: if they insist on 180d full request logs we'll need to cap retention for specific indices; discuss acceptable subset if cost becomes an issue.
sam_sales: Acknowledged. Pinging Raj privately to speed up LOA.
